observations: Photo 0: a disassembled metal housing with a toothed gear and long bolts/studs protruding from the casing, sitting on a dirty workshop floor.
Photo 1: a hand holding a similar cast metal housing with two circular bearing-like openings, long rods passing through it.
Photo 2: top view of a cast metal assembly with multiple bolt holes, a stamped mark reading '5-B' and a raised circular boss, no brand or part-number plate visible.
No Toyota logo, OEM part number, or VIN/tag is legible in any photo.
The assembly appears partly separated (bolts extended out, gear exposed) rather than a sealed, unopened unit.

identity.kind: engine oil pump / balance shaft assembly (claimed Toyota fitment)

claims.evidence: No casting number or Toyota part tag visible in any photo to cross-check fitment.
No import documentation, shipping label, or tag shown.
No video or bench-test clip showing the pump running or shafts turning smoothly.
No odometer photo or donor-vehicle history shown.
Photo 0 and photo 1 show the housing with bolts extended and a gear exposed, consistent with the unit having been removed/disassembled, not a sealed untouched part.

risks.risk: Internal gear/bearing wear or balance shaft chain stretch not visible from outside.
risks.proof: Close-up video of the shaft spinning freely by hand plus close-up of gear teeth and chain (if any) for wear.

risks.risk: Oil pump pressure/flow not verifiable from photos.
risks.proof: Bench test clip showing oil flow or pressure gauge reading.

risks.risk: Exact model/year fitment unconfirmed (Camry/RAV4 engines vary by generation).
risks.proof: Photo of casting number or OEM part sticker matched to a parts catalog.

risks.risk: Possible prior opening/repair hidden under re-sealed gasket surfaces.
risks.proof: Close-up of gasket mating surfaces and any sealant residue.
risks.if_unproven: priced as previously opened/used, not 'never opened'

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any casting/part number stamped on the housing.
Video of the shaft/gear turning freely by hand.
Bench test video showing oil pump pressure or flow.
Photo of gasket surfaces to check for prior opening or resealing.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used Toyota-type engine oil pump/balance shaft assembly by type, but all performance and originality claims are unverifiable from photos, and the 'never opened' claim is contradicted by visible disassembly, so it must be priced at worst case as a used, unverified-condition part.
